# Top app bar — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for the top app bar when a screen needs a name and a place for its actions. It is Material 3's bar in three sizes, and the composition family around it is what makes it useful in a real shell: `AppTopBar` is the app-level variant with the menus already wired, and the four `*Menu` exports are thin wrappers over one `TopBarMenu` — apps, help, notifications, user. Grouping them here rather than giving each a page is deliberate: they share one implementation and differ only in which items they show. The sizes are Material 3's and they change the bar's HEIGHT, so the shell can lay out against a known number.

### Usage

**Do**

- Name the screen in the title and keep the trailing slot to screen-level actions.
- Use `AppTopBar` for the shell header — the standard menus are already placed and wired.
- Reach for `TopBarMenu` directly when the menu is custom; wrap it only when the same items repeat.

**Don't**

- Don't invent a fourth size — the three Material 3 heights are the whole axis and the shell lays out against them.
- Don't rewire the `*Menu` wrappers per screen — if the items differ, that is a `TopBarMenu` with its own data.

### Tokens

| Element | State | Token | Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bar | resting | sys.color.surface | surface, 1px outline-variant base rule |
| Hover wash | hover | sys.color.surface-tonal | surface-tonal over controls and menu items |
| Menu | resting | sys.color.surface-container | surface-container, medium corners, level2 |

### Anatomy

| Part | Role |
| --- | --- |
| TopAppBar | The bar. Three sizes, leading slot, title, trailing actions — the screen's header. |
| TopAppBarToggle | The sidebar control. Reads `useSidebar()` itself, so the bar and the sidebar stay in sync with no props. |
| AppTopBar | The app-level bar with the standard menus already placed — the shell's header, not a blank bar. |
| TopBarMenu | One menu from `TopBarMenuItem[]`. The four `*Menu` exports are thin wrappers over this. |

### FAQ

**`TopAppBar` or `AppTopBar`?**

`AppTopBar` is the shell header with the standard menus placed — reach for it first. `TopAppBar` is the bare bar for screens that need their own composition.

**Which size?**

Small is the default screen header; medium carries a two-line title for top-level screens. The sizes change the bar's height, so the shell can lay out against a known number.

## Native

### Features

Reach for a top app bar on a native screen that has a title and one or two screen-level actions. It is the screen's header: where you are, and the things you can do from here. The size axis is the point — a small bar for most screens, a medium one when the title should carry weight. Keep the leading slot to one thing, usually back or menu, and the trailing slot to the actions that genuinely belong to the screen rather than to the app. If the screen has no actions and no need to say where you are, the bar is taking space for nothing.

### Usage

**Do**

- Give every screen that has actions a bar that names it — the title is the screen's identity.
- Pick the size by title weight: small for most screens, medium when the title should carry the screen.
- Keep the leading slot to one thing (back or menu) and the trailing slot to screen-level actions.

**Don't**

- Don't put app-level navigation in the trailing slot — that belongs to the drawer or rail, not the bar.
- Don't render a bar on a screen with no title and no actions — it takes space for nothing.

### Tokens

| Element | State | Token | Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bar | resting | theme.color.surface | surface, 1px outlineVariant base rule |
| Bar height | resting | fixed 64 / 112 | small and center fix 64dp, medium fixes 112dp |
| Action | resting | theme.color.onSurfaceVariant | 48dp touch target with a required label |

### Anatomy

| Part | Role |
| --- | --- |
| TopAppBar | The bar. Holds the title and the two slots, and fixes the screen's header height per size. |
| TopAppBarAction | An icon action sized to Material 3's minimum touch target. Its `label` is required — it is the action's name, not optional decoration. |
| TopAppBarToggle | The leading button that opens and closes the shell's rail or drawer. Its accessible name says what the press does (`Open navigation` while closed), and `expanded` carries the open state. |

### FAQ

**Which size?**

Small is the default screen header. Medium drops the title large across two lines for top-level screens. Center centers a small bar's title.

**How does this differ from the web top app bar?**

Same family, different member: the web bar is the shell composition with menus (`@xoroh/kern/start`), this one is the compact bar with leading/trailing slots. Both name the screen and hold its actions — switch tabs, not patterns.
